name: benefits-overview
title: Benefits overview
description: A family health-benefits screen: a member and category filter rail, search, the shared wallet, and every benefit as a row that opens for who's covered, how you pay and what to do next. Rows show used, unlimited, member-rate, fully used, locked and enrol states.

name: portfolio
title: Portfolio
description: A wealth dashboard, dark-first: sidebar, greeting and search, KPI tiles with sparklines, portfolio value over 24H/7D/1M/1Y, allocation, monthly investing, a deposit card, recent activity and a holdings table with inline trends.

name: dashboard-overview
title: Dashboard overview
description: An account overview: app header with a command menu, notifications and account menus, KPI tiles, an alert, recent activity and a quick-action form.

name: request-flow
title: Request flow
description: A three-step request with inline validation, an error summary, evidence upload with progress, a confirmation dialog and a success state.

name: settings
title: Settings
description: Tabbed account settings: profile form with photo upload, appearance, notification switches, active sessions and a danger zone.

name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: Email and password sign-in with a passkey option. A centred card on narrow containers, a two-column layout with a brand panel on wide ones.

name: activity-table
title: Activity table
description: A full data table page: search, status filter, sorting, row selection with bulk actions, CSV export, density, pagination, empty and loading states.
